items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: I never did hear anything about that band... I know of the hit of the band. It was his band.

ctx.x: A battle. A battle. A battle. A battle. Because you were working for certain people. You'd be playing for me and I. Another band was playing for somebody else. Well, we had a route. They had a route they wanted to make. You know. They played three or four tunes. One band would pull off. And people in the band would pull off. They didn't necessarily say that they lost. But they were working for some of them. This party was given that one to make it, you know. Make that route. Make it destination. Uh. Well, I used…

What about the St. Peter's band with Arnold De Pass? Yeah. I never did hear anything about that band. Could you tell me something about that band? Well in that band. The first band was Arnold. I know of the hit of the band.

It was his band. It was Elvin Coward. It was Benny Pinnum.
